diff --git a/mime/mime.go b/mime/mime.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b29cc2e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/mime/mime.go
@@ -0,0 +1,75 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"io/fs"
+	stdmime "mime"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/conf"
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/log"
+	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/resources"
+	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
+)
+
+const configFile = "mime_types.yaml"
+
+// LosslessFormats contains extension names without dots, loaded during configuration startup.
+var LosslessFormats []string
+
+type config struct {
+	Types    map[string]string `yaml:"types"`
+	Lossless []string          `yaml:"lossless"`
+}
+
+func init() {
+	conf.AddHook(func() {
+		if err := load(resources.FS()); err != nil {
+			log.Fatal("Error loading MIME types", err)
+		}
+	})
+}
+
+func load(fsys fs.FS) error {
+	data, err := fs.ReadFile(fsys, configFile)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", configFile, err)
+	}
+
+	var cfg config
+	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", configFile, err)
+	}
+	if cfg.Types == nil || cfg.Lossless == nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%s must define types and lossless", configFile)
+	}
+
+	for ext, typ := range cfg.Types {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(ext, ".") || len(ext) == 1 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid MIME extension %q in %s", ext, configFile)
+		}
+		if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(ext, typ); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("register MIME extension %q: %w", ext, err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	formats := make([]string, 0, len(cfg.Lossless))
+	for _, ext := range cfg.Lossless {
+		if !strings.HasPrefix(ext, ".") || len(ext) == 1 {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid lossless extension %q in %s", ext, configFile)
+		}
+		formats = append(formats, strings.TrimPrefix(ext, "."))
+	}
+	sort.Strings(formats)
+	LosslessFormats = formats
+
+	// Some Windows configurations report JavaScript as text/plain.
+	if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(".js", "text/javascript"); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if err := stdmime.AddExtensionType(".css", "text/css"); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	return nil
+}
diff --git a/mime/mime_test.go b/mime/mime_test.go

+++ b/mime/mime_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+package mime
+
+import (
+	stdmime "mime"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"testing/fstest"
+)
+
+func TestLoad(t *testing.T) {
+	oldFormats := LosslessFormats
+	t.Cleanup(func() { LosslessFormats = oldFormats })
+
+	fsys := fstest.MapFS{
+		configFile: &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("types:\n  .customaudio: audio/x-custom\nlossless:\n  - .customaudio\n")},
+	}
+	if err := load(fsys); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(".customaudio"); got != "audio/x-custom" {
+		t.Errorf("custom MIME type = %q, want audio/x-custom", got)
+	}
+	if want := []string{"customaudio"}; !reflect.DeepEqual(LosslessFormats, want) {
+		t.Errorf("lossless formats = %v, want %v", LosslessFormats, want)
+	}
+	if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(".js"); got != "text/javascript; charset=utf-8" {
+		t.Errorf("JavaScript MIME type = %q", got)
+	}
+	if got := stdmime.TypeByExtension(".css"); got != "text/css; charset=utf-8" {
+		t.Errorf("CSS MIME type = %q", got)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadRequiresBothFields(t *testing.T) {
+	fsys := fstest.MapFS{configFile: &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("types:\n  .flac: audio/flac\n")}}
+	if err := load(fsys); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected an error when lossless is missing")
+	}
+}
